name: The Cuckoo
text: Birds flying from beside this stay away a turn longer. End of Turn: Birds away with Nests beside this gain +2/+2.
golden_text: Birds flying from beside this stay away two turns longer. End of Turn: Birds away with Nests beside this gain +4/+4.
details: Each Cuckoo beside the departing Bird extends its trip once. Growth is permanent and comes home with the Bird.
